purpose: Extend the preregistered nine-case robustness block to all 30 independently generated randomized superquadrics without changing the estimator, optimizer, or evaluation protocol.
case_selection: All 30 cases generated before fitting are included. Cases 000--008 reuse the first three seeds from the completed five-seed matrix; cases 009--029 are new confirmatory fits.

guided_pso.estimator_resolution: Use each case's clean-derived data_resolution and model_resolution unchanged for every condition.
guided_pso.estimator_density_preprocessing: none; robust support affects initialization only

independent_evaluation.reference: analytic area-uniform surface generated from trait.json

reporting.stochastic_unit: Take the median of three paired seeds within each case before case-level inference.
reporting.robustness_unit: Pair each corrupted case median with the same case's clean median.
reporting.ems_comparison_unit: Pair each Guided-PSO case median with one deterministic EMS fit.
reporting.statistics: Exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over 30 independent cases.
reporting.failure_rule: Random missingness and spatially coherent cap occlusion remain separate conditions.
